confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July rates on Crete vary widely by location, season and booking lead time, so treat them as bounded ranges. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA page; I did not directly read the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Cretan and Greek island tourist towns such as Chania and Heraklion, adjusted for Rethymno's similar tourism profile, taverna and bar pricing, and July peak-season accommodation demand.
